report:
Telegram Notification AggregateError

### 📑 I have found these related issues/pull requests

From the changelogs, maybe related:
- https://github.com/louislam/uptime-kuma/pull/5637
- https://github.com/louislam/uptime-kuma/pull/5668

### 📝 Description

I switched to a freshly new uptime kuma instanz (installed as an app in truenas).  
Truenas installing docker container with `v2.0.0-beta.3`.
My old uptime kuma which is still working is also a docker container with `v1.23.16`.

My problem is that I can't get the Telegram notifications to work.
After I set up the bot and click on “test”, I get a toast with “AggregateError”.

I get the following in the Docker logs:
```js
2025-06-21 10:23:54.732108+00:00Error: Error: AggregateError 
2025-06-21 10:23:54.732278+00:00at Telegram.throwGeneralAxiosError (/app/server/notification-providers/notification-provider.js:116:15)
2025-06-21 10:23:54.732310+00:00at Telegram.send (/app/server/notification-providers/telegram.js:39:18)
2025-06-21 10:23:54.732329+00:00at process.processTicksAndRejections (node:internal/process/task_queues:95:5)
2025-06-21 10:23:54.732346+00:00at async Socket.<anonymous> (/app/server/server.js:1471:27)
```

### 👟 Reproduction steps

Create a new Telegram Notification.
My only settings are the "Friendly Name" `test123`, the bot token `123456789:xxxxxx` and the channel id `123456789`

Working bot, or better error logs please. 😅

evidence.quote: Cannot reproduce on my 2.0.0-beta.3. ... In order to view more details of AggregateError, may need to modify this function.

confirmation.quote: I have found my problem. TLDR: There was still an outdated name server set up in TrueNAS that caused the problem ... # ping api.telegram.org PING api.telegram.org (127.0.0.1)

ambiguity: Stack trace is entirely inside Uptime Kuma (notification-provider.js/telegram.js), labeled bug, fresh v2 beta install while v1 works, and reporter cites changelog PRs 5637/5668 -> D (regression in Telegram provider) is as plausible as C (host network/DNS) or A (Telegram API); 'AggregateError' names no external cause.
decisive_code: server/notification-providers/telegram.js:Telegram.send does only a plain axios.get to `${telegramServerUrl ?? 'https://api.telegram.org'}/bot<token>/sendMessage`; server/notification-providers/notification-provider.js:throwGeneralAxiosError just stringifies the axios error ('Error: ' + error) and appends response.data if any. No response body means the request never reached Telegram: AggregateError is Node's multi-address connect failure passed through verbatim, i.e. a network/DNS-level failure on the host, not provider logic.
notes: Container's stale Pi-hole DNS resolved api.telegram.org to 127.0.0.1; fixed by correcting TrueNAS name server; no code change. Caveat: maintainer verdict is only owner/collaborator "cannot reproduce"; issue still carries bug label.

reviews.decidable_why: Body only has a generic axios AggregateError; the DNS misconfiguration was discovered later by the reporter.
The body only shows a generic AggregateError from axios. Nothing in it points to DNS, and the code path is identical to working installs.
